name: One & Only Gorilla's Nest
insider_take: This ultra-luxury lodge sits at the edge of Volcanoes National Park, offering the world's most exclusive gateway to Rwanda's legendary mountain gorillas.
whats_special: One & Only Gorilla's Nest is Rwanda's first ultra-luxury resort, positioned at 7,000 feet elevation with breathtaking views of the Virunga Mountains. The property features only 21 rooms, ensuring an intimate experience while serving as base camp for once-in-a-lifetime gorilla trekking adventures. The lodge's design incorporates local volcanic stone and celebrates Rwandan culture through indigenous art and materials.
pro_tip: Book your gorilla trekking permits well in advance - only 96 permits are issued daily for all of Volcanoes National Park, and this lodge offers priority access and expert guides.
dont_miss: The golden monkey tracking experience, visits to Dian Fossey's research center and tomb, and the hotel's signature "Gorilla Guardian" program where you can participate in conservation efforts. The spa treatments using local volcanic clay and the traditional Rwandan coffee ceremony at sunrise are equally unforgettable.
pros: Exclusive access to gorilla trekking experiences in Volcanoes National Park
Ultra-luxury eco-lodge with sustainable design and conservation focus
Exceptional spa treatments inspired by Rwandan wellness traditions
Personalized service with dedicated butlers and expert local guides
cons: Remote mountain location requires helicopter or lengthy drive access
Ultra-premium pricing reflects exclusive safari lodge positioning
This property is not available for online booking.
